title: USS John F. Kennedy orb and systems failure
summary: Richard Dolan tells of USS John F. Kennedy orb and systems failure, about 1971 at USS John F. Kennedy at sea, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: USS John F. Kennedy at sea

tellings.quote: says. July 2nd, 1971. It's 8:30 at night. He's running the comms [clears throat and cough] and he said all the in inbound communication starts spouting gibberish.

plain: A writer on UFO history, Richard Dolan, relays the testimony of a man named James Cop, given to the Disclosure Project, a group that collected statements from people about government knowledge of UFOs. Cop says that on July 2, 1971, at 8:30 at night, he was running communications aboard the aircraft carrier USS John F. Kennedy when all incoming messages turned into gibberish, and the story ties this to a glowing orb and a failure of the ship's systems. If true, it would mean an unknown object could knock out a warship's equipment.
